title: Unique one-step lifting of formal-fibre idempotents
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be any morphism of schemes, $s\in S$, and $n\in\mathbb N$. Put $A=\mathcal O_{S,s}$ and $\mathfrak m=\mathfrak m_s$, and use $X_n=\operatorname{Spec}(A/\mathfrak m^{n+1})\times_S X$ and $j_n:X_n\to X_{n+1}$ of [def-weil-pbc-formal-fibre-cohomology]. Every idempotent $e\in\Gamma(X_n,\mathcal O_{X_n})$ has exactly one idempotent lift $e^{\prime}\in\Gamma(X_{n+1},\mathcal O_{X_{n+1}})$ satisfying $j_n^*(e^{\prime})=e$. No properness, Noetherian or henselian hypothesis is required.

proof.text: For A and m as in the statement, in B=A/m^(n+2) the image J of m^(n+1) has square zero because 2(n+1) ≥ n+2. The quotient isomorphism B/J ≃ A/m^(n+1) identifies its quotient map with factorPow. Pullback pasting identifies the base change of X_(n+1) along Spec(B/J) → Spec(B) with X_n, and the projection with j_n.

Apply nilpotent_baseChange_idempotents to X_(n+1) → Spec(B), J, N=2 and J^2=0. Transport the existence and uniqueness of idempotent lifts along the preceding pullback isomorphism. This also covers n=0, e=0, e=1 and empty fibres.
